newsitem.title: UK: Bankers Trust appoints Attali CEO of French office.
newsitem.headline: Bankers Trust appoints Attali CEO of French office.

text.p: Bankers Trust said on Thursday it had appointed Bernard Attali as a managing director and president director general of Bankers Trust France.
Attali, former chairman of the supervisory board of Arjil & Cie Investment Bank, will report to Philippe Souviron, vice-chairman of Bankers Trust International, Bankers Trust said in a statement.

The statement said Attali would work on developing senior client relationships and play a key role in the bank's global strategy in mergers and acquisitions, real estate, corporate finance, capital markets sales and trading and risk management services in the French market.
Attali's previous posts include chairman of Air France and chairman of GAN Insurance Group.
